user_query: My family and I are planning a vacation and we need to manage our finances. Can you provide the results for the Nordigen analysis of our bank statement? Also, find some popular tokens for decentralized finance (DeFi) and recommend cross-chain bridges to ensure secure transactions during the trip.

TaskList.description: Analyze the bank statement using Nordigen API to provide insights on financial health and spending patterns.
Retrieve and list popular tokens in the decentralized finance (DeFi) space for investment and transaction purposes.
Identify and recommend cross-chain bridges that provide secure transactions for the selected DeFi tokens.
